cues.text: Let's create and manage a gate pass.
Open Hostel and Gate Passes, then press New Gate Pass.
Choose the student and the pass type, then enter the reason and where the student is going.
The leaving time and the expected return are already filled in. Change them if the student leaves at a different time.
Press Create Gate Pass. It starts as Pending Approval.
Press Approve, add a remark if you like, and confirm.
When the student leaves the gate, press Check Out.
When the student is back, press Mark Returned, and the pass is complete.
